name: A2U Internet
summary: Sydney web-hosting/dialup ISP ('Adap-2-Us', ATU Internet Pty Ltd, est. 1997); merged with Viper in 2001 to form Independent Service Providers Pty Ltd (ABN 28 096 599 352), reusing Viper's existing isp.net.au domain.

events.details: Adap-2-Us established (ATU Internet Pty Ltd); Sydney web hosting, dialup and 'VISP'/virtual-ISP wholesaling. Every atu.net.au capture carries a © 1997–1999 footer.

Merged with Viper.net.au in 2001 to form Independent Service Providers Pty Ltd (ABN 28 096 599 352). The isp.net.au domain was Viper's pre-existing domain (serving Viper content from Oct 2000) that was repurposed for the merged entity, not created by the merger; exact month not archive-verified (transition falls between May 2001 and 2002).
source: isp.net.au addressing 'Viper or ATU customer?', © 2001 ISP: https://web.archive.org/web/20020525011550/http://www.isp.net.au/
